summary: Surah 25 ayahs 1-77: all 10 high NEAR findings and 45 low XREF/UNFOUND findings were false positives (cross-references/neighbouring ayahs, orthographic normalisation), 14 books semantically sampled (6+ each) with Arabic/TR/EN agreeing on the same ayah. One source problem: nahhas-irab:33-33 text is about 25:32 (continuation of the 31-32 entry). Eight books have selective-coverage GAPs. No translation fixes needed.
